name: surf
setup: . scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
. scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && { test -f next-env.d.ts || printf '/// <reference types="next" />\n/// <reference types="next/image-types/global" />\n' > next-env.d.ts; }
notes: Env: commands assume $RM (router-migrate root) and $SRC (working copy) are exported and scripts/env.sh is sourced (setup does this itself); run every step under `env -u RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY`. Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0 (npm cache redirected by env.sh). Install: `npm ci` from the committed package-lock.json (662 packages, ~7s); npm 11 allowScripts skipped the install scripts of bufferutil/msw/sharp, which tsc does not need. The repo has no test script, no test framework and no CI workflow. Its only test-like file, lib/streaming/resolution.test.ts, is a console-logging diagnostic script with no assertions (and no tsx/ts-node is installed to run it), so it yields no pass/fail counts. test_cmd is therefore a strict TypeScript typecheck (TS 5.8.2, strict: true, 45 project files, --incremental false so no tsconfig.tsbuildinfo is written). Setup writes the standard gitignored next-env.d.ts (`next dev`/`next build` would create it); error count is the same (4) with or without it. Baseline: exit 2 with 4 PRE-EXISTING `error TS2345` errors, all in lib/streaming/resolution.test.ts (lines 101, 278, 330, 388: number[] not assignable to [number, number]); production files typecheck clean. parse_counts returns all None for this output (no test counts), as expected for a typecheck. `next lint`/`next build` not used (build may fetch Google Fonts via next/font/google, i.e. network). 2 runs: identical (exit 2, 4 errors).
